name: Spirit Rise
summary: Spirit Rise gathers Thunder Bluff’s spiritual and shamanic study on its northwest mesa. The Skychaser tribe guides seekers above the Pools of Vision, where seers look into spirit-touched waters.

sections.title: A Sanctuary of the Spirits
sections.body: Spirit Rise crowns Thunder Bluff above the plains of Mulgore, devoted to communion with the elements and ancestor spirits. Rope bridges link it to the central mesa. The Hall of Spirits and the Spiritual Healing pavilion draw young and veteran shaman seeking a deeper bond with earth, air, fire, and water. The Skychaser tribe keeps a strong presence across the rise and guides seekers in ancient traditions.

sections.title: Caves and Crossings
sections.body: Beneath the open-air totem shrines and huts, an entrance leads into the mesa. The steamy Pools of Vision fill a sacred cavern below, where seers peer into waters touched by the spirits.

faq.q: What is Spirit Rise known for?
faq.answer: Spirit Rise is the spiritual heart of Thunder Bluff, devoted to shamanic practice, healing, and communion with nature spirits and ancestors. It also opens onto the Pools of Vision.

faq.q: Which tauren tribe leads activities on Spirit Rise?
faq.answer: The Skychaser tribe guides activity on Spirit Rise, fostering spiritual traditions, divination rituals, and shamanic training.

faq.q: What can I find underneath Spirit Rise?
faq.answer: A descent through Spirit Rise leads to the Pools of Vision, a humid cavern of steaming waters where seers and spiritual practitioners meditate and seek visions.

angles.text: As a shaman of the Horde, Spirit Rise is an essential gathering place to consult trainers, perform elemental rites, and commune with ancestral spirits.
As a tauren, you find your people’s deep spiritual roots on the rise, with solace from secular duties and the mystical waters of the Pools of Vision.
